g.text: FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT (1950) · T. HEINZ AIA
RL-06: MITERED BATTERED STANDING-SEAM COPPER PROW
▲ REDLINE RL-06..07 · REV P03.1 AS-BUILT FIELD VERIFICATION
ROOF FASCIA FIX: Replaced flat vertical edge with 18° Outward-Battered Standing-Seam Copper Fascia (0.58m O.C. 3D seams).
ROOF DECK & CHIMNEYS: Updated membrane to Dark Charcoal-Olive; added 4 polygonal Desert-Rubblestone Chimneys w/ Bronze Caps.
SKYLIGHT WELL FIX: Added Raised White Curb Platform (Roof_Skylight_Curb_Platform), White Exterior Ribs & 3 North Vaulted Hoods.
